svg.title: Cello Mesh — the decodable field (C** data model, atom-weave)
svg.desc: The whole particle population as a dense zoomable field: atoms (mainkey pill + sc pebbles + dashed .c feather-stubs) laid in a weave — depth to band, mainkey to cluster with a jewel halo, atoms to grid. A graded twist channel warps a few atoms amber/red (a wound) and one purple (intentional sc.twist:'effect').
svg.text: the snap rendered as a decodable field — atom-weave of the whole C** population
··· more req motes at field zoom — width still encodes N_sc

g.text: ··· req · Step-child · LE motes — the field continues below the zoom floor
